{{Quote|A man's got to relax and have an ale from time to time. Good for the soul.|[[Roly Melusar]]|<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>}}
'''Ale''' was a frothy,<ref name="DV" /><ref name="DS" /> yeast-based,<ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref> potentially [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage, with a thick, sweet smell.<ref name="RP" /> Some types of ale, like the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] ale [[Kri'gee/Legends|kri'gee]], had a bitter taste.<ref name="ORR" /> Ale was made in a process called brewing.<ref name="Indomitable">[[Legacy (2006) 20|''Legacy'' (2006) 20]]</ref> It was produced in breweries, dedicated buildings for the making of ale, for which the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Clendor]] was famous.<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> It could also be brewed at home, for personal consumption.<ref name="Indomitable" /> An "ale house" was a tavern where ale was sold.<ref name="Tinian on Trial">{{JournalCite|4|Tinian on Trial}}</ref> Ale could be stored in special containers called kegs,<ref name="Tempest Feud">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref><ref name="Scourge novel">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> and was sometimes served in "pints".<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>
